scope: Six requested municipalities; current published code/data, no new visual shoreline validation

numerical_geodesy.reference: pyproj.Geod WGS84; no remote grids or data changes
numerical_geodesy.scope: Compares the numeric offset to ellipsoidal separation of displayed endpoints; does not validate shoreline extraction or image accuracy.

test_result.scope: Existing logic and data consistency checks, not independent physical shoreline validation

confirmed_code_findings.finding: Missing 2010/2011 photographs produce a model-based reference.
Default current view is scenario; all 2010-2026 years remain selectable.
Unvalidated scenarios use signed red/green before unresolved-direction styling is checked.
Uncertainty is an undocumented mixture of source accuracy, fixed 3 m and spread; it is not a standard uncertainty budget.
Independent quadrature is used for the two positional indicators; correlation and total physical error are not resolved.

recommended_review_protocol: Classify measured photographic endpoints, reconstructed references, interpolated endpoints and missing data separately.
Use an explicitly observed baseline date for each profile; label Hunucma/Rio Lagartos 2010 references instead of claiming 2011.
Start with a short Progreso pilot; co-register dates using multiple stable land features and independent check points.
Trace a consistent visible shoreline proxy at the exact dated source and scale; review independently and log adjudication.
Intersect the traced line with fixed, locally checked transects; define handling of multiple/no intersections.
Recompute signed differences only from approved endpoint positions; keep original data, hashes and corrections separately.
Quantify registration, digitization, proxy and environmental uncertainties, including shared terms and unknowns.
Treat >40 m changes as review candidates only; large changes are not inherently incorrect.
selection_definition: 2025 analysis at each municipal default centre using municipalDatedOptions and scenarioReferencePhoto with previousRelease=null; per-point acquisition dates may differ within a release. Separate best-edition counts inspect all 22 received releases.
